name: Pigmentation Genetics
description: 10-gene pigmentation panel covering hair, eye, and skin colour. Key variants from HIrisPlex-S and GWAS literature.

genes.notes: Major red hair / fair skin gene. R variants (rs1805007 R151C, rs1805008 R160W, rs1805009 D294H) are high-penetrance.
Oculocutaneous albinism type 2. Also associated with blue/brown eye colour.
rs12913832 is the strongest single predictor of blue vs brown eye colour. Acts as enhancer for OCA2.
MATP gene. rs16891982 (L374F) strongly associated with light skin in Europeans.
rs1426654 (A111T) nearly fixed in Europeans. Major light skin variant.
Tyrosinase. Rate-limiting enzyme in melanin synthesis. Mutations cause OCA1.
Tyrosinase-related protein 1. Mutations cause OCA3 (rufous albinism).
rs12203592 associated with freckling, brown hair, and skin pigmentation.
KIT ligand / stem cell factor. rs12821256 associated with blonde hair.
Agouti signalling peptide. Antagonist of MC1R. rs6058017 associated with darker pigmentation.
